desc: Derive and prove the rooted-forest interpretation: each legal operation reflects a consecutive child interval and mirrors selected subtrees.
Characterize reachable tree states: every node’s children can be independently transformed and arbitrarily permuted, with no residual orientation constraint.
Identify the exact recursive grammar: a node serializes any permutation of one independently reachable serialization from each original child.
Design a polynomial-time counting DP/canonicalization for the recursive unordered-permutation grammar, correctly avoiding duplicates from equal reachable child forms.
Implement and validate a Python solution with modular arithmetic and sample tests.
